summary.text: Zui Xian Weng is an Eastern Sea rank seven Gu Immortal who created a sea of wine, conceals countless wines there, and holds a wine reception every year.

claims.text: Fang Yuan names him when weighing who else might gather the world’s top quality wines and form a new divine travel Gu: among those rivals he places this Eastern Sea rank seven Gu Immortal beside Fei clan wine and Northern Plains imperial court long life wine.
He is an elderly Gu Immortal with a reddened nose.

Central Continent talk later places him in Wine Emperor’s food path line. Shi Lei calls Wine Emperor a food path rank eight expert whose life’s work was the three sovereign five emperor wines, and states that after Wine Emperor died and left an inheritance, the Eastern Sea Gu Immortal Zui Xian Weng became the one hundred and thirty-seventh inheritor.
When Eastern Sea Gu Immortals gather around Qi Sea Ancestor, he appears as a rarely seen food path Gu Immortal and brings a thousand jars of top tier wines as a gift.

During that research, Eastern Sea immortals who need food path experts invite him as a famous Eastern Sea lone immortal; he has connections with most righteous path forces but is not then in Eastern Sea.

In Central Continent, an elderly Gu Immortal with a reddened nose reaches a rank eight true inheritance in an underground cave. The awakening will says that to obtain the true inheritance of himself and his wife, the seeker must agree to take revenge on a traitorous disciple named Wu Shuai.

He names himself an Eastern Sea Gu Immortal, Zui Xian Weng. Green Ant Ascetic’s will asks whether he is willing to oppose Fang Yuan for the true inheritance; after a long silence he agrees, makes the vow, and then accepts the inheritance. That inheritance holds Green Ant Ascetic’s enslavement path inheritance and Wine Fairy’s food path true inheritance, including the food path killer move golden bottle drunken wine; he values Wine Fairy’s portion far above the enslavement path line. Qin Ding Ling traps him as he leaves, refuses a formal agreement that Fang Yuan might notice, tells him to return to Eastern Sea and join the Righteous Qi Alliance, and asks for a copy of the true inheritance while offering relevant Immortal Gu. She later tells Fang Zheng that Zui Xian Weng can endure hardship, knows his circumstances, possesses one of the three pools in the world named Wine Pool, cultivates food path solely, and can almost be treated as a representative figure of that path, while the inheritance line behind him has been passed down stably. After he drinks her tea, she states she has already used a method to influence his luck so he will become Fang Yuan’s enemy.

After he inherited Green Ant Ascetic and Wine Fairy’s true inheritance in Central Continent and was persuaded by Qin Ding Ling to act as a chess piece, he returned to Eastern Sea, rested, and took the initiative to side with the Righteous Qi Alliance. The alliance welcomes him as an outstanding Eastern Sea lone cultivator whose wide ties with large Eastern Sea righteous forces make his joining a political model for other lone and demonic immortals. When the Righteous Qi Alliance had wanted to invite him earlier, he had already gone to Central Continent and was secretly searching for Green Ant’s true inheritance. At the welcoming banquet he offers spring sea blossom wine; when Qi Sea Ancestor misnames it spring wind petals wine, he thanks the Ancestor for bestowing the name and flatters without correcting the slip.
Heavenly Court later credits him with infiltrating the Righteous Qi Alliance and obtaining first-hand information on the lingering poisonous ant plague used in Eastern Sea.

Inside the alliance he exchanges contribution points for ice and snow path immortal materials and, in treasure yellow heaven, buys a seller’s remaining immortal materials by paying with those goods, while a rank six lone immortal who had been bargaining cannot match his wealth or supply the materials requested.

On a later Eastern Sea patrol, Xia clan Gu Immortals plan to escape with rare wine meant for him, but Heavenly Court has instructed him to let them go; he watches them leave, regrets his promise to Qin Ding Ling, and names himself Heavenly Court’s spy inside the Righteous Qi Alliance.
